readings.commitment: Constitutional government is the ancient balanced polity, where limitation comes from mixing the social orders against one another rather than from a written instrument
readings.delta: Suppression operates between orders (each checks the others' ambitions); beneficiary is whichever order currently holds the balance; victim set is the unenfranchised below all orders; extractiveness moderate, contested between orders

readings.commitment: Constitutional government is an unwritten accumulation of statute, convention, and precedent, in which the constitution is whatever the constitutional actors have come to treat as binding
readings.delta: Low formal suppression, high conventional suppression (breach is unthinkable before it is illegal); beneficiary is incumbent institutional actors who know the conventions; victim set is outsiders to the tradition; extractiveness low and procedurally veiled

readings.commitment: Constitutional government is a deliberate founding act, in which a people constitutes its government from first principles in a single authoritative written instrument
readings.delta: Suppression concentrated at the founding moment (the document forecloses pre-revolutionary forms); beneficiary is the founding coalition and its successors-in-interpretation; victim set is those excluded from the founding bargain; extractiveness fixed by entrenched compromise

readings.commitment: Constitutional government is a rights-anchored reconstruction adopted after catastrophe, designed above all to make the prior regime's abuses structurally impossible
readings.delta: Suppression aimed backward at the defeated regime type (militant-democracy clauses, eternity clauses); beneficiary is the protected individual against the state; victim set is movements resembling the proscribed past; extractiveness low, judicially policed

readings.commitment: The Roman Republic's constitution is the paradigm of balanced government, distributing power among magistrates, senate, and assemblies so that no order could rule alone
readings.delta: Suppression by mutual veto (collegiality, tribunician intercession); beneficiary is the senatorial order operating the machine; victim set is the provinces and the unpropertied; extractiveness high at the imperial periphery, contested at the center

readings.commitment: The Athenian politeia is the paradigm of citizen self-rule, in which sortition, rotation, and the assembled demos kept government from hardening into a separate ruling class
readings.delta: Suppression of professionalized office (lot defeats accumulation); beneficiary is the adult male citizen body; victim set is women, metics, and the enslaved who financed the leisure of citizenship; extractiveness displaced onto the excluded

readings.commitment: The British constitution is the original unwritten constitution, an evolved settlement of parliamentary sovereignty tempered by convention and the common law
readings.delta: Suppression by convention (what is not done is not done); beneficiary is Parliament and the governing class fluent in its usages; victim set is those relying on entrenched rights that do not exist; extractiveness low, revisable by simple majority

readings.commitment: The Westminster model as exported is a written codification of unwritten practice, transplanting parliamentary government into societies that had no part in evolving it
readings.delta: Suppression of pre-colonial governance forms; beneficiary is the local successor elite inheriting the colonial state; victim set is communities whose institutions the transplant displaced; extractiveness inherited from the colonial template

readings.commitment: The United States Constitution is the durable revolutionary constitution, a short entrenched framework that has absorbed two centuries of transformation through amendment and interpretation
readings.delta: Suppression by entrenchment (Article V supermajorities); beneficiary is whoever the frozen compromise currently advantages; victim set is majorities blocked by counter-majoritarian structure; extractiveness fixed at founding, relitigated through interpretation

readings.commitment: The French Constitution of 1791 is the revolutionary constitution as rupture, the attempt to rebuild the state from declared rights that consumed itself within a year
readings.delta: Maximal suppression of the ancien régime (feudal forms abolished by enumeration); beneficiary is the active citizen propertied class; victim set is passive citizens and the dispossessed clergy; extractiveness redirected, not reduced

readings.commitment: The Stalin Constitution of 1936 is the revolutionary constitution as facade, enumerating extensive rights while actual power ran entirely through the party apparatus it never mentions constraining
readings.delta: Total suppression behind nominal guarantee (the text conceals rather than constrains); beneficiary is the party apparatus; victim set is everyone the apparatus designates; extractiveness maximal and constitutionally invisible

readings.commitment: The Basic Law is the paradigm of militant postwar constitutionalism, entrenching human dignity beyond amendment and arming the state against democracy's enemies
readings.delta: Suppression aimed at regime-type recurrence (eternity clause, party bans); beneficiary is the rights-holding individual; victim set is movements adjudged hostile to the free democratic order; extractiveness low, court-policed

readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution is postwar constitutionalism at subcontinental scale, an exhaustive document attempting social revolution by constitutional text in a society of deep inherited hierarchy
readings.delta: Suppression of inherited caste hierarchy by enumeration (abolition, reservations); beneficiary is the historically subordinated, by design; victim set per the document is the old hierarchy's beneficiaries; extractiveness redirected by affirmative mandate

readings.commitment: The 1947 Japanese Constitution is imposed postwar constitutionalism, a victor-drafted charter renouncing war and sovereignty-theology that the polity nonetheless made its own
readings.delta: Suppression of the prior imperial-sovereignty doctrine; beneficiary is the postwar citizen and the occupying power's settlement; victim set is the displaced imperial institution and revisionists; extractiveness low, anchored by Article 9's renunciation
